question: In Arc 5, Wilhelm-san was supposed to be only a little stronger than Garfiel, but in Arcs 9 and 10, he trained himself again and became incredibly strong. Could you tell us how strong he is now? If he fought the current Nine Divine Generals, how many of them could he defeat?
answer:
Wilhelm-san is a little more motivated in Arcs 9 and 10, and he is extremely strong (laughs). There are stages like “Young Wilhelm-san who did not know love,” “Young Wilhelm-san who came to know love,” and “Old Wilhelm-san,” and at the current stage, he should be quite close to “Young Wilhelm-san who came to know love.”

Wilhelm-san himself says things like, “I still have a long way to go compared to when I was young,” but I think he may be about as strong as he was in his youth, or perhaps even stronger.

As for how many of the Nine Divine Generals he could defeat, I think he could take down anyone except Cecilus. I want him to be at a level where he can.

That said, it's questionable whether he is always stronger than Arakiya, so I would like you to take it more in the sense that “Wilhelm has become incredibly strong in situations where it really counts.”

From this point onward, there will probably be more occasions where Wilhelm-san gets into battles, so I hope you'll look forward to those as well!
